newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS, Lufthansa cargo deal does well.
newsitem.headline: SAS, Lufthansa cargo deal does well.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System(SAS) and German Lufthansa's co-operation on cargo services as part of the two carriers' strategic alliance is doing well, Lufthansa CEO Wilhelm Althen said in an SAS in-house magazine published on Wednesday.

"The alliance between SAS Cargo and Lufthansa Cargo is a good example of co-operation which will strengthen the two airlines' competitiveness," Althen told SAS' Scandinavian Cargo Times in an interview.

"I am convinced this is the way ahead. Co-operation on cargo services had been quietly developing offering customers a combination of SAS Cargo's natural advantages as a national carrier coupled with Lufthansa Cargo's global capacity and network," he said.

The cargo co-operation between the two airlines takes the form of a merger of handling operations and facilities at some destinations, closer collaboration on sales in smaller markets as well as a co-ordination of freight systems.
SAS and Lufthansa formed a strategic alliance with effect from January 1, 1996.
